headline: Miscreants fire shots at Asif Akbar's car in Maghbazar, singer unharmed as he was not present
summary: The popular singer and former BCB director was not in his vehicle during the early morning attack in Dhaka. Police are investigating the incident, with motives and perpetrators currently unknown.
details: Miscreants fired shots at the personal car of popular singer and former BCB director Asif Akbar in Dhaka's Maghbazar area. The incident occurred around 5 AM on Saturday, October 24.
Police confirmed that Asif Akbar was not inside the vehicle at the time of the shooting, ensuring his safety. He remained unharmed despite the attack on his car.

The identity of the perpetrators and their motive behind the shooting remain unknown. Authorities are investigating whether the incident is linked to any personal or professional disputes involving the singer.
Asif Akbar is a prominent figure in both the music industry and the cricket arena, having also served as a former director of the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB).
caption:
Popular singer Asif Akbar's car was targeted in a shooting incident in Dhaka early Saturday morning. Fortunately, the singer was not in the vehicle and remained unharmed.

Miscreants fired shots at the personal car of popular singer and former BCB director Asif Akbar in Dhaka's Maghbazar area. The incident occurred around 5 AM on Saturday, October 24.

Police confirmed that Asif Akbar was not inside the vehicle at the time of the shooting, ensuring his safety. He remained unharmed despite the attack on his car.

The identity of the perpetrators and their motive behind the shooting remain unknown. Authorities are investigating whether the incident is linked to any personal or professional disputes involving the singer.

Asif Akbar is a prominent figure in both the music industry and the cricket arena, having also served as a former director of the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB).

headline_marked: [[Shops, malls return to 8 PM closing time]] after temporary Durga Puja extension
headline: Shops, malls return to 8 PM closing time after temporary Durga Puja extension
summary: The temporary permission for shopping malls, markets, and shops to stay open until 10 PM for Sharadiya Durga Puja expired on Friday, October 22. They will now operate from 11 AM to 8 PM daily.
details: Shopping malls, markets, and shops across Bangladesh have returned to their previous operating hours, closing at 8 PM daily. This change came into effect on Friday, October 22, following the expiration of a temporary extension granted for Sharadiya Durga Puja.

The temporary permission, issued by the Power Division on October 5, allowed these establishments to remain open until 10 PM. This special allowance was valid until October 22, specifically to accommodate increased shopping during the festive season.

The directive explicitly stated that the pre-determined schedule would be reinstated from October 23. Consequently, all shopping centers are now permitted to operate from 11 AM to 8 PM, adhering to the standard hours.

The original directive to close shops and malls by 8 PM was issued on August 12 as part of the government's efforts to save electricity and manage power consumption. This measure aimed to reduce the overall energy demand across the country.

Additionally, the Power Division had also instructed that no decorative lighting should be used in shops and shopping malls after 7 PM. This guideline remains in effect, reinforcing the broader energy conservation strategy.
